diffs.diff: header pin 3: part says SCL, datasheet reading says TX/SCL
diffs.evidence: Sensirion SCD30 datasheet v1.0 (May 2020), section 3 'Pin-Out Diagram', Figure 2: third pin is 'TX/SCL' - 'Modbus: Transmission line (Push/Pull with 3V level) / I2C: Serial clock (internal 45kOhm pull-up resistor, pulled to 3V, for higher voltages a level shifter is needed)'. Same physical pin and same position (VDD, GND, TX/SCL, RX/SDA, RDY, PWM, SEL); the model names it by its I2C function SCL (its interface is I2C, SEL floating/GND) and its description states 'Printed TX/SCL on the module'. Only the label differs, not the pin or its function.

diffs.diff: header pin 4: part says SDA, datasheet reading says RX/SDA
diffs.evidence: Sensirion SCD30 datasheet v1.0 (May 2020), section 3 'Pin-Out Diagram', Figure 2: fourth pin is 'RX/SDA' - 'Modbus: Receive line (Input must not exceed 5.5V) / I2C: Serial data (internal 45kOhm pull-up resistor, pulled to 3V, for higher voltages a level shifter is needed)'. Same physical pin and same position; the model names it by its I2C function SDA and its description states 'Printed RX/SDA on the module'. Only the label differs, not the pin or its function.
